transcript: 7 Foods Diabetics Should Eat Before Bed If your morning sugar is always high, try eating these 7 foods before going to sleep. 1. Cottage Cheese Its slow, digesting protein helps keep your glucose stable through the entire night. 2. Almonds Healthy fats plus fiber slow down glucose release and prevent overnight spikes. 3. A Boiled Egg Zero sugar, high protein and one of the best stabilizers for the night. 4. Chia Pudding Packed with fiber that works like a slow release system for your blood sugar. 5. String Cheese Quick, easy and with a perfect balance of fat and protein, ideal for a snack that does not spike anything. 6. Greek Yogurt Choose one with no added sugar. Its protein helps you avoid that morning sugar surge. 7. Avocado Healthy fats that slow digestion down and prevent those early morning highs. These 7 foods all have something in common. They slow down glucose release during the night so your body does not have to fight while you sleep. But I want you to understand something. Your sugar does not rise just because of what you eat or stop eating. It rises because of how you live. Stress triggers cortisol and cortisol triggers glucose. Every night you go to bed with your mind racing worried tense. Without releasing the day your body pumps out cortisol as if you were in danger. And that cortisol raises your sugar even if you have not eaten a thing. That is why there are people who eat well, follow every recommendation and still wake up with their sugar through the roof. Because their body spent the entire night in emergency mode. Eating these foods before bed helps. But if your nervous system is still on alert your sugar is going to keep rising. Write in the comments health if you are going to try this tonight. And if you want to learn how to calm or truly spikes your sugar, the stress, the anxiety, the tension your body never releases. I spent over 20 years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And everything I know is inside the way back to stillness. The link is in my profile.
